itinerary.title: Cairo: the plateau
itinerary.source: Day one opens with the monuments that organised Egypt's reputation for the rest of history.

itinerary.title: Cairo: museum and the medieval city
itinerary.source: The second day moves from the plateau to the city, and from the pharaonic to the medieval.

itinerary.title: Cairo: the invention of the pyramid
itinerary.source: The third day reaches back past Giza to the point where large-scale stone architecture began.

itinerary.title: Alexandria: the Mediterranean city
itinerary.source: The Alexandria day is built as a single long return drive rather than an overnight, which keeps the hotel stay anchored in Cairo and the packing minimal.

itinerary.title: Transfer to Cairo International Airport for departure
itinerary.source: The fifth day is a transfer day: a final breakfast and the drive back to Cairo International Airport for departure, with later flights giving the option of additional hours in the city.
